# platform.claude.com documentation — Models

> 19 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation under Models. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Models

- [Overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5/overview.md): Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's most capable widely released model, built for the most demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work.
- [How it compares](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-4-5/overview.md): The fastest model with near-frontier intelligence
- [How it compares](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/mythos-5/overview.md): Most capable model for cybersecurity and biology research
- [How it compares to the current lineup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-4-5/overview.md): Although Claude Opus 4.5 is still available, you should consider migrating to Claude Opus 5 for improved performance.
- [How it compares to the current lineup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-4-6/overview.md): Although Claude Opus 4.6 is still available, you should consider migrating to Claude Opus 5 for improved performance.
- [How it compares to the current lineup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-4-7/overview.md): Although Claude Opus 4.7 is still available, you should consider migrating to Claude Opus 5 for improved performance.
- [How it compares to the current lineup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-4-8/overview.md): Although Claude Opus 4.8 is still available, you should consider migrating to Claude Opus 5 for improved performance.
- [Overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5/overview.md): Claude Opus 5 is a step-change improvement over Claude Opus 4.8, with the largest gains in deep reasoning, agentic and long-horizon tasks, and test-time compute scaling.
- [How it compares to the current lineup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-4-5/overview.md): Although Claude Sonnet 4.5 is still available, you should consider migrating to Claude Sonnet 5 for improved performance.
- [How it compares to the current lineup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-4-6/overview.md): Although Claude Sonnet 4.6 is still available, you should consider migrating to Claude Sonnet 5 for improved performance.
- [Overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5/overview.md): Claude Sonnet 5 is the next generation of Anthropic's Sonnet model family.
- [Models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5/introducing-claude-fable-5-and-claude-mythos-5.md): Claude Fable 5 includes safety classifiers that can decline certain requests. Claude Mythos 5 does not include these classifiers, so this section applies to Claude Fable 5 only.
- [Models overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview.md): Claude is a family of state-of-the-art large language models developed by Anthropic.
- [Migrating to Claude Haiku 4.5 from Claude Haiku 3.5 and earlier Haiku models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-4-5/migration-guide.md): These breaking changes apply when migrating from Claude 3.x Haiku models.
- [Migrating to Claude Mythos 5 and Claude Fable 5 from Claude Mythos Preview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5/migration-guide.md): [Claude Mythos 5](https://anthropic.com/glasswing) is the access-gated successor to [Claude Mythos Preview](https://anthropic.com/glasswing), the invitation-only research preview.
- [Migrating to Claude Opus 5 from Claude Opus 4.8](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5/migration-guide.md): This section covers the delta from Claude Opus 4.8 only.
- [Migrating to Claude Sonnet 5 from Claude Sonnet 4.6](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5/migration-guide.md): If your code is on Claude Sonnet 4.5 or earlier, also apply [Migrating to Claude Sonnet 5 from Claude Sonnet 4.5 and earlier Sonnet…
- [New model](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5/whats-new-opus-5.md): You can add or remove tools between turns of a conversation while preserving the prompt cache, instead of resending a fixed tool list for the life of a session.
- [New model](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5/whats-new-sonnet-5.md): On Claude Sonnet 4.6, requests without a `thinking` field run without thinking.
